rows.summary: Autonomous objective discovery relies on intrinsic motivation and collaborative multi-agent frameworks to bootstrap exploration in environments lacking external reward signals. While these methods achieve state-of-the-art performance in open-ended search, their reliance on specific convexity assumptions limits their applicability to non-convex optimization landscapes, necessitating further development in autonomous goal prioritization.
